newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia says ASEAN needs to discuss Japan's ideas.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia says ASEAN needs to discuss Japan's ideas.

text.p: Indonesian Foreign Minister Ali Alatas welcomed on Thursday Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto's proposal to seek regular summits with ASEAN members but said the seven-member group must discuss the idea.

"In principle, we welcome the idea, but it must be agreed to by all ASEAN members. ASEAN needs to discuss it," Alatas told reporters, adding Japan already had a forum at the ministerial level with the grouping.
The Association of Southeast Asian Nations groups Brunei, Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Thailand, Singapore and Vietnam.

In a speech on Tuesday in Singapore, Hashimoto called for regular summits with regional leaders, joint efforts to preserve traditional Southeast Asian cultures and collaboration on global concerns such as terrorism and the environment.
Hashimoto's speech capped a week-long visit to Malaysia, Indonesia, Brunei, Vietnam and Singapore.
